case_study.heading: Living with Lolo
case_study.subhead: A luxury interior design and design-build firm in Scottsdale, Arizona, and the first business to run on the Cited Co system. Monthly tracking went live in March 2026. The numbers below are from four consecutive automated scans.
case_study.footnote: Source: four consecutive automated Cited Co scans, March to June 2026, across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini. 48 tracked queries.
case_study.takeaway_body: When Living with Lolo is mentioned, it is almost always first. The improvement came primarily from positioning gains, moving from 2nd or 3rd to 1st, rather than appearing in entirely new queries. Sixteen queries still return zero mentions, and the pattern is consistent: pricing and comparison questions the site has no content answering. Two targeted content pieces, one on pricing structure and one on the design-build model, are the identified next step and are expected to move those queries in the following scan cycle. This is the playbook.

pull_quote.quote: Overall AI visibility grew from 42% to 65% in three months. Claude visibility moved from 17% to 75% in 60 days. First-place positioning on 23 of 48 tracked queries.
